Header: Orseolia oryzae Anaikomban or onion shoot

Prevention: Plough the field after harvest & keep land fallow during off season.
Remove the alternate hosts ( Oryza glaberrima , Oryza longistaminata ) and three grasses viz. , Eleusine indica , Bothriochloa sp. and
Root dipping of seedlings in chlorpyriphos 20
EC 2 ml per lit of water for 20 min before transplanting in
Monitoring: Setup a light trap per acre and monitor the adult flies
Observe economic threshold level 10 % silver shoot
Direct Control: Platygaster oryzae parasitised galls at 1/10 m2 on 10 days after transplanting (DAT)
Oil 3% at 30 ml per liter 15 days after transplanting
Restrictions: Use of personal protective equipment (PPEs) such as gloves, mask, goggles and keeping antidotes are mandatory by the spray applicators.
